title: Polynomial encoding of a binary vector
statement: For a binary vector $\gamma=(\gamma_0,\ldots,\gamma_{n-1})$ and a binary extension field of degree $\ell$, define the polynomial $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}\gamma_i X^{i+1}$ over that field, viewing each coefficient through the canonical embedding of $\mathbb{F}_2$ into the extension field.
